item.title: Urawa Jukunichi Festival: A Daruma Doll New Year Market — Guide
item.description: Urawa Jukunichi is a traditional New Year market held each January, when the streets around Chōjuji Temple fill with stalls selling daruma dolls — round, hollow, red-and-white papier-mâché figures traditionally purchased to set an intention or wish for the coming year, with one eye painted in upon purchase and the second added once the goal is achieved. The festival’s name, meaning ‘19th day,’ reflects its traditional date, and the lively atmosphere of vendors, food stalls and crowds seeking fortune makes it a distinctly local slice of Japanese New Year culture.
